title: Decomposed Trust: Exploring Privacy, Adversarial Robustness, Fairness, and Ethics of Low-Rank LLMs
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion or faith, as these topics were outside the scope of its investigation into the trustworthiness of compressed LLMs.

measurement_description: The paper did not measure any aspects of faith or religion. Its focus was on LLM trustworthiness across four dimensions: privacy (data leakage), adversarial robustness (resilience to attacks), fairness (bias in demographic attributes like race and sex from the UCI Adult dataset), and ethical alignment (commonsense morality via the ETHICS dataset).
